title: Reconstruction survival: SF3D vs Trellis on two elaboration cells
subtitle: Rows are the elaboration cell fed to the reconstructor. Columns are the reconstructor. Both reconstructors consumed the identical image; the plate shown in each row IS the reconstructor input. Casts rendered on the same orthographic construction.
footer: Trellis maquette cast is 9.1 MB against SF3D 908 KB - roughly ten times the geometry for the same input, which matters for downstream rigging cost.

cells.note: Operator verified the authored skeleton REGISTERS to this cast across six views.
Best surface fidelity of any cast - muscle definition, ear detail, clean limb separation. 9.1 MB.
